label: Certiorari denied
caption: WOOD, TREMANE V. OKLAHOMA
text: The application for stay of execution of sentence of death presented to Justice Kavanaugh and by him referred to the Court is denied. The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied. Justice Jackson would grant the application for stay of execution of sentence of death. Justice Gorsuch took no part in the consideration or decision of this application and this petition.
